description_en: Associates a shared permission with a resource share
description_zh: 调用AssociateResourceSharePermission为共享单元关联共享权限
name: AssociateResourceSharePermission

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource share
parameters.name: resource_share_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the shared permission
parameters.name: permission_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the specified permission replaces the existing permissions. Valid values:
false (default): no. The existing permissions are not replaced. This value is suitable for adding the current permission to a resource share that has no permissions. Because a resource share can have only one permission for each resource type, if a resource type in the resource share already has a permission and you set Replace to false, an error is reported. This prevents you from accidentally replacing the existing permissions.
true: yes. The permission for the same resource type in the resource share is replaced
parameters.help_zh:
指定的权限是否替换现有权限。取值：
false（默认值）：否，不替换现有权限，适合于将当前权限添加到没有权限的共享单元。由于同一个共享单元中相同资源类型只能具有一个权限，如果共享单元中某资源类型已经有设置权限，同时您将Replace设置为fasle，此时该操作会报错。防止您误操作替换现有权限。

true：是，替换共享单元中相同资源类型的权限
parameters.name: replace
